preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= N for x in P)
preconditions.description: Every element in P is an integer between 1 and N inclusive.
The length of P is exactly N.
P is a permutation of length N (all elements are distinct).
The length of the permutation N is at least 2.

postconditions.description: The final permutation is sorted in increasing order.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= N and 1 <= j <= N and i != j for (i, j) in operations)
postconditions.description: Each operation consists of two distinct indices i and j within the valid range [1, N].

postconditions.expression: sum(abs(i - j) for (i, j) in operations) == min_total_cost
postconditions.description: The total cost of all operations equals the minimum total cost to sort the permutation.
The number of operations K matches the number of operations listed.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= N and 1 <= j <= N for (i, j) in operations)
postconditions.description: All operations involve valid indices within the permutation bounds.
